description: This file contains the implementation of a serializer, surrogate, and copier for the ImmutableHashSet<T> type in the Orleans.Serialization framework. It defines how to serialize, deserialize, and deep copy ImmutableHashSet instances, including handling of key comparers and surrogate serialization.

classes.name: ImmutableHashSetCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for ImmutableHashSet<T> that converts to and from a surrogate representation.

classes.name: ImmutableHashSetSurrogate<T>
classes.description: Surrogate type used for serializing ImmutableHashSet<T>, including its values and key comparer.

classes.name: ImmutableHashSetCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier for ImmutableHashSet<T> that handles deep copying of contained elements.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate representation back into an ImmutableHashSet<T>.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts an ImmutableHashSet<T> into its surrogate representation for serialization.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an ImmutableHashSet<T>, handling cyclic references and shallow copying when necessary.
